newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel diffs near steady despite stock build.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel diffs near steady despite stock build.

text.p: U.S. prompt jet fuel differentials ended near steady Wednesday despite the build in U.S. inventory levels last week.
On the NYMEX, August heating oil futures fell 0.27 cent to settle at 52.68 cents a gallon.
U.S. Gulf prompt 54-grade jet fuel traded at 0.15 cent under the August NYMEX, while barrels for upline delivery on the Colonial Pipeline traded at even to the futures.
Prompt New York Harbor 54-grade jet fuel hovered between 2.00 and 2.25 cents over the futures.
The weekly American Petroleum Institute inventory report released Tuesday showed a build in jet fuel stocks of nearly 1.8 million barrels.
"I'm surprised," one trader said, "I with that type of build we would have come off."
